verdict.rationale: Gmail's own docs say users can ask Gemini in natural language to act on the mailbox, such as deleting multiple emails or adding labels. Gemini can also summarize threads, draft or refine emails, and propose meeting times from Calendar availability, so the core of operating Gmail by natural-language command is covered. Missing for 10: documentation of how far commands reach beyond organize, draft, summarize and schedule (e.g. sending, filters, settings); independent or hands-on corroboration that the commands work as described.
